title: Derived-limit property of a tower limit cone
statement: Let A be an abelian category with exact countable products and enough injectives, with derived category D(A) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] equipped with any chosen countable products and localization functor Q. Let I be a K-injective cochain complex of inverse systems indexed by the opposite of the natural numbers, let K be a sequence of objects of D(A), and let f_n: K_{n+1} → K_n be its transition maps. Given an isomorphism from I.asFunctor followed by Q to the tower (K,f), every limit cone c of I.asFunctor has Q(c.pt) as a derived limit of (K,f) [def-weil-derived-limit].

proof.text: Apply the canonical localized-evaluation-tower triangle theorem to I and c, obtaining the connecting map δ for the fixed product lift of the localized cone projections.

Use Pi.mapIso on the components of the supplied representation e. Naturality of e at every successor transition gives commutation with 1-shift via towerTransitionEndomorphism_natural_backward. The component isomorphisms (identity, product isomorphism, product isomorphism) define a Triangle.isoMk, whose first arrow is p followed by the product isomorphism and whose third arrow is its inverse followed by δ. Mathlib distinguished_iff_of_iso transports distinguishedness. Package these maps as IsDerivedLimit.

theorem derivedCategory_towerLimit_property
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCountableProducts A] [CountableAB4Star A]
    (hP : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A)) :
    letI : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A) := hP
    ∀ (_ : EnoughInjectives A)
      (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective]
      (K : ℕ → DerivedCategory A) (f : ∀ n : ℕ, K (n + 1) ⟶ K n)
      (_e : I.asFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ≅ Functor.ofOpSequence f)
      (c : Cone I.asFunctor), IsLimit c →
      IsDerivedLimit f (DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt)
